data.action: 温室钢琴旁弹完旋律向镜头点头，捧花里藏着给妹妹的花
data.description: 【学校温室音乐室·午后】玛夏穿着暖白婚纱坐在钢琴旁，浅棕卷发从头纱两侧落下，捧花里夹着一枚妹妹喜欢的花朵；她弹完一小段旋律后向镜头点头，笑容像一封写给家人的信。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light through glass and leaves
data.location: greenhouse music room at the academy
data.mood: 把照顾家人的心意写成花嫁
data.promptProse: Mariya Mikhailovna Kujou (Masha) from Alya Sometimes Hides Her Feelings in Russian wears a warm white bridal gown with a soft veil, light-brown ribbon, pearl buttons and a bouquet of family flowers. She sits beside the greenhouse piano with a bouquet holding a flower chosen for her sister. After playing a quiet phrase, she turns toward the viewer and inclines her head with a considerate smile, warm glass light settling across her wavy hair. warm afternoon light through glass and leaves.
data.title: 玛夏 · 温室钢琴旁的温柔花嫁
